sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 negative: request with no origin is refused at clause 1
sys_atf_test.description: A governed request carrying neither sam_request_id nor ritm nor a declared break-glass must stop at clause origin and must not reach authorize.

sys_atf_step.description: No origin fields at all; assert the chain stops at 'origin'.
An unresolvable sam_request_id must also be refused - a claimed origin is not an origin.
